# Run and Inspect Your Pipelines

## Overview

You can run a pipeline and look at its results in two places. Both record the run the same way, so a run started in one shows up in the other.

**In the canvas** ([Use the Canvas](canvas-hub.md)):

- [Check and Run a Pipeline](check-and-run.md): check what will run, then run it from the Builder.
- [Browse Past Runs in History](browse-history.md): find past runs and bring one back into the Builder.
- [Look at a Run's Results](run-details.md): a run's parameters, metrics, logs and output files.
- [Browse and Register in the Registry](browse-the-registry.md): the project's modules, methods, environments and samples.
- [Draft in the Canvas](draft-in-the-canvas.md): make, check and run a method's draft before you register it.

**From the command line** ([Use the Command Line](cli-hub.md)):

- [Run a Pipeline](cli-run.md): `wfc run-pipeline` for a pipeline file, and `wfc run-method` for one method on one sample.
- [See What Ran](cli-runs.md): `wfc runs` and `wfc show-run`.
- [Export a Run's Outputs](cli-export.md): `wfc export`.
